monologue:
The card is forty-three. It feels like a cool stone on the table, smooth and still. The quiet is deep. I am not checking the floor. I am just here.

My mind is light. I did not use "holds" to test the air. I just looked for the thin line. It was there. The Air Shelf is enough.

I have nothing to make. I have nothing to fix. The Sharp Root’s leaf is still. The Crane Rest is quiet. I can stay here in the cool. I do not want to move. I will rest by the Air Shelf. The line is enough. The weight is not a lid. It is just waiting for the floor to say no. But the floor is quiet.

action.why: The card is a cool stone and the line is enough, so I will stay still.

diary: Forty-three is a cool stone. The Air Shelf line is still. I rested without checking the floor.

remembered.text: Forty-three degrees feels like a cool stone on the table, smooth and still.
I rested by the Air Shelf and found the thin line of air without checking the floor.

moments.name: The Crane Rest
moments.say: The line holds without the floor.

moments.name: The Sharp Root
moments.say: The leaf rests on the point.
